text: A single CW pump laser feeding a high-Q microring can generate a broadband coherent optical frequency comb via cascaded four-wave mixing; the stable state that yields a sech²-shaped comb spectrum is called a dissipative Kerr ___.
explanation: The dissipative Kerr soliton (DKS) is a stable, self-organized pulse circulating in the ring that produces a coherent, evenly spaced frequency comb. Such combs supply many wavelength channels from one pump for WDM photonic matrix processing.
